posts.t:
Considering the urge for the #Jets to build a team that can be competitive right away, it’s of a surprise the only skater they got in the Hellebuyck trade who will make an immediate impact is Dawson Mercer.

Command & prospects will help them in the long run, not now #NHLJets

🚨 BLOCKBUSTER TRADE! 🚨 

Connor Hellebuyck is headed to the New Jersey Devils in a MASSIVE deal!

The Winnipeg Jets receive Dawson Mercer, Alexander Command, Nico Daws, Nick Bjugstad, a 2029 second-round pick, and a 2027 seventh-round pick in return.

Who won this trade? 👀

threads.t: With Nick Suzuki injured, Moritz Seider and Dawson Mercer are now tied for the longest streak of consecutive games played to begin their NHL careers
